usage: This library defines the standard security schemes for APIs.

clientIdEnforcement.description: This API supports Anypoint's Client ID Enforcement authentication policy.

Authorization.description:
Used to send the Base64 encoded the client "id:secret"
credentials

401.description:
Unauthorized. Either the provided client id and secret
combination is invalid, or the client is not allowed to
access the content provided by the requested URL.

oidcEnforcement.description: This API supports OpenID Connect OAuth 2.0 for authenticating all API requests.

Authorization.description: Used to send a valid OAuth 2 access token.

401.description: Unauthorized: invalid token, expired token, or connection error when connecting to the authorization server.

settings.authorizationUri: Use IdP's authorization URL.  Not used for Client Credentials or Password grant types.
